thread:
sara: quick checkin on the continuous-batcher followup. i prototyped a tiny lease contract that minimizes payloads and separates provisional vs final accounting. want quick feedback before i wire into adapters.

leo: nice. main win is smaller RPCs right? how do you handle adapter warmup hints without embedding blobs in the lease?

sara: exactly. warmup_hint is an opaque token (string) that references the hotstore entry. adapters can write/read the hotstore separately. lease = (id, deadline_ms, credit_est). tiny by design.

maria: prefer that. keep scheduler data model minimal. two cautions: revocations must be low latency and provisional credits need TTLs. we burned cycles hunting leaks last time.

sara: agreed. sketch below:

```
message CompactLease {
  string id = 1;           // short uuid
  uint64 deadline_ms = 2;  // authoritative
  uint16 credit_est = 3;   // provisional estimate
  string warmup_token = 4; // points to hotstore
}

rpc AcquireLease(AcquireReq) returns (CompactLease);
rpc ReleaseLease(ReleaseReq) returns (Empty);
// Revocation: server-side streaming Revoked { string lease_id }
```

leo: streaming revocations are ok. what if adapter misses a revoke due to network partition? scheduler should detect stale leases on dispatch.

sara: plan: dispatch checks lease still active in ledger; if missing or revoked, skip. plus reconciler sweeps provisional ledger with TTL (default 5s) and reconciles to scheduler credits.

tim: rollout plan? recommend dual-mode: keep the legacy path, add a shim that translates old calls to new contract so we can FF. start with 5% for adapters behind a flag.

infra-bot: NOTE: created issue #INF-2491 "compact-lease-proto + hotstore tokens" (link: https://redwood/INF-2491)

maria: operational notes: add metrics measuring provisional_credit_hold_time, revoked_leases_count, lease_sequence_mismatch. alert if provisional_credit_hold_time > 70% of deadline.

sara: also adding a debug-only verbose lease that has an extra metadata blob. verbose mode only enabled via admin header to avoid perf regressions.

leo: one more: packing interactions. if adapter prefetch uses credits, but scheduler later packs requests into a single GPU batch, we must ensure final accounting isn't double-charging. suggestion: adapter reports provisional credits with a provisional_id; scheduler consumes final credits at dispatch and atomically clears provisional entries for that provisional_id.

sara: yup that'll be part of the shim contract. implement a lightweight atomic reconcile RPC: Reconcile(provisional_id) -> success or conflict. if conflict, adapter abandons prefetch and releases provisional credits.

maria: include failure tests: adapter crash, reconciler lag, lease ledger corruption, scheduler restart. we need deterministic recovery hooks.

tim: perf note: keep lease id short (base62). avoid long uuids in hot paths. and prefer numeric deadlines (ms since epoch) over RFC strings.

sara: thanks. i'll iterate on the proto and push a small PR with shim + unit tests. will wire metrics and a feature-flagged rollout plan (5% -> 25% -> 100%).

leo: ping me when PR is up, i'll review the reconcile path.

maria: i'll help with test scenarios. thanks all.
